decisionProcess.demandMechanism: Transient rooms and limited operational meeting/catering demand for HYROX event staff, visiting leadership, suppliers and partners supporting the February 2027 Cancún race.
decisionProcess.summary: A strong named travel lead and several operations/local-event contacts are visible, but the actual hotel-sourcing workflow is not. Central travel ownership is plausible because HYROX has a Head of Travel & Business Development, while local event operations are also clearly staffed. Whether Mexico uses local discretion, a TMC, a preferred chain or a separate meetings procurement process is unknown.
decisionProcess.notes: Approach Courtney first for travel/sourcing qualification and copy or seek referral to Joaquin or the Mexico event-experience/operations team. Do not claim contracting authority until the booking process is confirmed.
unknowns: No named person was evidenced as the contracting authority for hotel accommodation in Mexico or Cancún.
No preferred-hotel program, TMC, procurement process, travel policy or local booking discretion was found.
No room-night estimate, traveler count, meeting agenda, catering scope or budget was published.
The hotel's official address, website, brand and proximity/transport relationship to Malecón Tajamar are unresolved in the supplied hotel context.
